Construct complete UCDP analytical panels

Source: R/aggregate.R
ucdp_panel.Rd

ucdp_panel() completes the entity-period combinations in an aggregated data set. It can also aggregate raw data first when unit is supplied. Inserted rows are always identified by .ucdp_observed and .ucdp_fill, so zero-filled combinations are never indistinguishable from source groups.

Usage

ucdp_panel(
  data,
  unit = NULL,
  id = NULL,
  date = NULL,
  by = NULL,
  start = NULL,
  end = NULL,
  universe = NULL,
  fill = c("zero", "missing"),
  include_fatalities = TRUE,
  low = NULL,
  best = NULL,
  high = NULL,
  na_rm = TRUE,
  missing = c("drop", "error")
)

Arguments

data

Raw UCDP observations or output from ucdp_aggregate().

unit

Aggregation unit used for raw data. It may be omitted when data retains the ucdp_aggregation attribute.

id, date, by, include_fatalities, low, best, high, na_rm

Passed to ucdp_aggregate() when raw data are supplied.

start, end

Panel boundaries. Use four-digit years for yearly panels and "YYYY-MM" strings or dates for monthly panels. Defaults to the observed range.

universe

Optional entity universe. Supply a vector for a one-column entity key or a data frame containing all entity and by columns. The default uses combinations observed at least once in data.

fill

Should inserted combinations contain explicit zeroes in numeric aggregate columns or missing values?

missing

Passed to ucdp_aggregate() for raw data.

Value

A complete panel tibble. .ucdp_observed is TRUE only for groups present in the aggregated input; .ucdp_fill is "observed", "zero_filled", or "missing".

Examples

events <- data.frame(
  country_id = c(1, 1, 2), year = c(2020, 2022, 2021),
  low = c(0, 1, 2), best = c(1, 2, 3), high = c(2, 3, 4)
)
panel <- ucdp_panel(
  events, unit = "country-year", start = 2020, end = 2022
)
panel[c("country_id", "year", "n_events", ".ucdp_fill")]
#> # A tibble: 6 × 4
#>   country_id  year n_events .ucdp_fill 
#>        <dbl> <int>    <int> <chr>      
#> 1          1  2020        1 observed   
#> 2          1  2021        0 zero_filled
#> 3          1  2022        1 observed   
#> 4          2  2020        0 zero_filled
#> 5          2  2021        1 observed   
#> 6          2  2022        0 zero_filled
